blurb: Davis Lanes offers bowling with state-of-the-art lighting and sound, including Extreme Bowling on Friday and Saturday nights. They have leagues for men, women, couples, youth, and special groups, plus a full menu of food and beverages. The facility includes a lounge for adults 21 and older and a pro shop for bowling equipment.
